text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got a huge dream! I'm gonna run in 
the Twinkle Series for sure... and become 
a splendid "city girl"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still not really used to the big 
city, but... I won't lose to anyone when 
it comes to guts! Please whip me into 
shape!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
